programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times.
